import json, subprocess, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp')
from check import decode
from audit import audit

TESTS = []
def add(name, case):
    TESTS.append((name, {"cases": [case]}))

BURST = [{"version": 0, "repeat": 3, "addresses": ["::", "::1", "ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff"]}]
add("empty fib", {"initial": [], "transactions": [], "bursts": BURST,
                  "cache_pages": 0, "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 8, "decode": [0, 1, 2]}})
add("empty fib no burst", {"initial": [], "transactions": [], "bursts": [],
                           "cache_pages": 5, "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 8, "decode": [0, 1, 2]}})
add("default only", {"initial": [["::/0", 0]], "transactions": [], "bursts": BURST,
                     "cache_pages": 12, "costs": {"hit": 16, "miss": 256, "decode": [16, 16, 16]}})
add("default null", {"initial": [], "transactions": [[["set", "::/0", 0]]],
                     "bursts": BURST, "cache_pages": 12,
                     "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 1, "decode": [0, 0, 0]}})
add("all same hop", {"initial": [["::/1", 4], ["8000::/1", 4]], "transactions": [],
                     "bursts": BURST, "cache_pages": 3,
                     "costs": {"hit": 2, "miss": 9, "decode": [0, 1, 2]}})
add("empty transactions", {"initial": [["::/0", 3]], "transactions": [[], [], []],
                           "bursts": BURST, "cache_pages": 1,
                           "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 3, "decode": [0, 0, 0]}})
add("max fanout", {"initial": [["::/0", 1]] + [["%x:/112" % i, i + 2] for i in range(1, 9)],
                   "transactions": [], "bursts": BURST, "cache_pages": 12,
                   "costs": {"hit": 1, "miss": 100, "decode": [0, 0, 0]}})
for name, req in TESTS:
    payload = json.dumps(req).encode()
    env = dict(os.environ, FIDX_ENGINE='/workspace/tmp/engine')
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=payload,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
    if p.returncode:
        print('FAIL %-22s nonzero %s' % (name, p.stderr[:400])); continue
    actual = decode(p.stdout)
    try:
        audit(req, actual, actual)   # self-consistent gold
        print('PASS %-22s objective=%s R=%s' % (name, actual["cases"][0]["objective"],
              [len(v["starts"]) for v in actual["cases"][0]["versions"]]))
    except Exception as e:
        print('FAIL %-22s %r' % (name, e))
EOF
